The arts, and ballet in particular are important for a 
community the size of Palm Beach County. Our

performance opportunities; our community needs 
outreach programs that bring the arts to the young

to give what they have been trained and gifted to 
do! Ballet Palm Beach is the organization doing all

professional ballet company and school to continue 
to bring the art of dance to Palm Beach County.
